title: Python widgets — Code, Sandbox, ParametricExplorer
description: Python-execution widget family running on the Pyodide worker: a graded Code exercise, an open Sandbox, and a ParametricExplorer with live sliders.

sections.title: Code — graded Python with hidden tests + peek solution

data.taskMarkdown:
**Code widget.** A CodeMirror editor + Pyodide worker + hidden test runner. The user iterates with ▶ Run, then clicks Submit to grade against the test list. Tests are hidden by default; a Peek solution disclosure reveals the reference implementation without auto-injecting it.

**Task.** Implement `add` so it returns the sum of two numbers.
data.solution:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

sections.title: Sandbox — open-ended Python (no tests, no Submit)

# Sandbox widget. Free-form Python — runs in the lesson's shared Pyodide namespace.
